## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 48 dishes, 13 Israel-specific (rank 23).
- [[FmLAMA]]: 10 dishes (63 rows). [[World Wide Dishes]]: 1 dish.
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈20 recipes.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] has religious-cultural tags rather than a country label: `kosher` 4,446, `jewish-ashkenazi` 612, `jewish-sephardi` 185.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Israeli FCT in the vault; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by ingredient name.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[KNApSAcK Family]]: 273 records (150 edible / 123 medicinal). [[CMAUP]]: 45 plants (41 scraped). [[NPASS]]: 25 pairs. [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 1 record.
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 42 values (14 concentrations, 28 intake–biomarker correlations).
- Compounds and health effects come only from the [[Global]] resources ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[NPASS]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No composition data and few recipes with amounts; no BLEnD or ArabCulture file.
